doc: Every registry and field name Kiln's registry schemas have published, with its numeric id (schema.g.h's field ids), the version that published it and its contract (kind, applies, ops, read-only, range, values), and each registry's version history. Names and ids are never reused: a field that leaves its schema moves to "retired" (registrygen.py retire, only in a breaking step). Within one breaking line (0.<minor> while experimental, <major> from 1.0.0) a field may only be added, widen its range, append enum values or apply earlier; anything else needs the next breaking version and schema/registry/migrations/<registry>-<from>-<to>.json. Written by tools/registrygen/registrygen.py lock; never edit it by hand.
